visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a high-definition close-up of a plated cold jellyfish salad (Liangban Haizhesi). A hand using wooden chopsticks lifts a bundle of glossy, translucent jellyfish strips mixed with vibrant green cucumber and red chili shreds. The lighting is bright and evenly distributed, highlighting the fresh textures of the ingredients. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a middle-aged male chef in a professional white uniform with pink trim. He stands in a modern, well-lit kitchen studio and speaks enthusiastically toward the camera while gesturing. A large clear bowl filled with pale yellow jellyfish strips sits on the wooden countertop in front of him. (3) Chronological steps show hands in transparent plastic gloves washing and soaking the jellyfish in a glass bowl filled with water. The camera switches between eye-level shots of the chef and top-down views of the preparation. (4) Close-up views show the addition of sauce ingredients into a small glass bowl: white sugar, minced garlic, dark vinegar, sesame oil, thick soy sauce, and bright red chili oil. Each ingredient is added in sequence. (5) The sauce is poured over the jellyfish and mixed by hand. Sliced cucumbers, chopped green onions, and shredded red chilies are added to the bowl. Hands thoroughly toss the mixture to ensure even coating. (6) The video concludes with a close-up, rotating presentation of the finished dish on a white rectangular plate, garnished with fine julienned vegetables. The lighting remains bright, creating an appealing culinary aesthetic.
